# IDIOT Pedals

> Handcrafted boutique guitar effects pedals engineered and built in Burdwan, West Bengal, India.

## Storefront & Navigation
- [Homepage](https://idiotpedals.shop/): Brand overview, flagship Distortion ONE showcase, controls, and hardware specifications.
- [All Pedals](https://idiotpedals.shop/products): The Workbench Collection catalog with live INR pricing and availability.
- [Distortion ONE](https://idiotpedals.shop/products/6b01fb7a1b894093dece8351): Flagship boutique high-gain analog distortion guitar pedal.
- [About Our Workbench](https://idiotpedals.shop/about): Engineering philosophy and small-batch manufacturing in Burdwan, India.
- [Contact & Builder Support](https://idiotpedals.shop/contact): Direct builder inquiries, rig troubleshooting, warranty claims, and order assistance.

## Flagship Product: Distortion ONE
- **Brand:** IDIOT Pedals
- **Category:** Boutique Guitar Effects Pedal (Analog High-Gain Distortion / Fuzz)
- **Origin:** Hand-wired and bench-tested in Burdwan (Bardhaman), West Bengal, India
- **Currency & Availability:** Priced in Indian Rupees (INR), inclusive of all taxes; live stock and pricing available at https://idiotpedals.shop/products/6b01fb7a1b894093dece8351
- **Bypass Switching:** Mechanical 3PDT true-bypass
- **Power Standard:** Standard 9V DC center-negative (2.1mm barrel) pedalboard power supply
- **Impedance:** 500k Ohm input / 10k Ohm output
- **Shipping:** Free insured doorstep delivery across India
- **Warranty:** 365-day (1-year) bench warranty against component defects
